question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Affected by an undesirable condition or unpleasant feeling
solution: The correct answer is **"Stricken."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Stricken"** means seriously affected by an unpleasant feeling or disease or by a difficult situation. ((किसी अप्रिय भावना, रोग या कठिन परिस्थिति से) ग्रस्‍त) • **Example**: *We went to the aid of the **stricken**__ boat.* • So, the one word for **"a****ffected by an undesirable condition or unpleasant feeling"** is** "stricken."** • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Cancelled** means to call off or annul something. (पूर्वनियोजित कार्यक्रम, निर्णय आदि को रद्द करना, निरस्‍त करना) • **Indifferent** means having no particular interest or sympathy; unconcerned. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु में रुचि या सोच-विचार से रहित; उदासीन) • **Modest** means unassuming or moderate in one's opinion or estimate of one's abilities. (विनम्र, विनीत (अपनी क्षमताओं आदि का बखान न करने वाला)) 34:Tb56, The correct answer is **"Alluring."**
